scope: Bounded KAG3 semantic facade and shared prerequisites (ADR 0088)
integration: Original existing TJS2/KAG crates unchanged; no new source copied from upstream general engine/render/audio/font/media implementations. Stock KAG3 scripts are external test inputs only.
limitations: No complete game compatibility, TJS runtime snapshot, full native save stacks, XP3 auto-mount, nonuniform alpha query, native focus/modal/video or nonidentity gamma claim.

files.review: Complete original 1557-line native parser facade, including callbacks, tag conversion, properties and save/restore mapping. Reference only; not imported.
Complete KagHost trait and selected complete parser load/tag/control/macro/callback/save conversion functions. The existing parser remains unchanged.
Complete selected execute/resume and nested execution frame merge paths, to preserve the original VM continuation instead of emulating a second stack.
Selected complete WaveSoundBuffer property/open/play/stop/fade functions; selected native Layer getter and Window/Timer declarations. No general engine modules imported.
Native shift state constants and existing native identifier values; source reference only.

Complete invalidate_object path: script finalize is dispatched before native host invalidation, even when a script overrides the native finalize. Shared audio cleanup is attached to the native instance boundary as well.
Complete stock startup; retained unchanged as external runtime input.
Complete 280-line original initialization sequence.
Complete 531-line native conductor, deferred trigger and timer/wait/stop flow.
Selected complete constructor, scenario/tag, input, save variable and wait glyph handlers.
Selected complete initialization, draw and click/hit-test handlers.
Selected complete image/color correction, atlas load/copy and animation task handlers.
Selected complete primary click/province routing and native mouse handlers.
Complete stock 24-pixel cell animation commands; external generated test sheet matches its 384x24 extent.
Complete stock page wait animation commands; external generated test sheet matches its 384x24 extent.
Complete 342-line parser declaration/state layout.
Selected complete native store/restore functions and method/property registration, checked against original reload/GoToLabel and field meanings.

Complete _HitTestNoVisibleCheck, HitTestNoVisibleCheck and native onHitTest entry: only a positive primitive hit invokes the callback; super.onHitTest writes native work state, return values are ignored. Also reviewed complete GetMostFrontChildAt traversal/disabled-hit blocking and native adjustGamma entry.
Complete native hideMouseCursor entry, delegates to the window instance.
Complete native HideMouseCursor delegation.
Complete HideMouseCursor, SetMouseCursorState, RestoreMouseCursor and SetMouseCursorVisibleState: temporary hiding ends when the observed mouse position moves.
Complete inline GetNodeVisible/GetNodeEnabled semantics and parent visibility/enable declarations; modal entry remains unsupported.
Intact gamma data and complete AdjustGamma function: exact identity returns without pixel mutation. Other gamma algorithms are not implemented/copied.
